# VinaX

> No-login music-streaming web app (PWA) and Android app. Personalization lives on your device; an AI DJ builds queues, with synced lyrics, offline downloads and shared listening. Tuned for regional and Indian music — Telugu, Hindi, Tamil and more.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/): Personalized, AI-arranged music home
- [Search](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/search): Search songs, albums, artists and playlists
- [Charts](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/charts): Trending charts
- [Movies](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/movies): Film soundtracks
- [Moods](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/moods): Music by mood
- [For You This Week](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/weekly): A personalized weekly mix
- [AI Playlist](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/ai-playlist): Build a playlist from a text prompt
- [About](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/about): What VinaX is and who makes it
- [Help](https://www.sirimillavinay.online/help): Help and FAQ

## Notes

- No account or login is required to use VinaX.
- Audio is sourced from public music APIs and is not hosted by VinaX.
- Canonical origin is https://www.sirimillavinay.online (with www).
